div.ab: Gif man mannes esne gebindeþ, VI scll' gebete.

Gif man mannes esne gebindeþ, VI scƚƚ gebete.
Wenn man jemandes Lohnknecht bindet, so büsse man [dem Herrn] 6 Schll.
If someone binds a person’s hired servant, let him pay [the master] 6 shillings.
If a man lays bonds on another man’s servant, he shall pay 6 shillings compensation.
If anyone binds a man’s servant, he is to pay six shillings compensation.
If a person binds a person’s servant, let him pay [with] 6 shillings.

note.seg: [Ändere ² in ¹] Verletzung des Schutzes (s. d. Gl 20a IV) des Gemeinfreien; ebd. 15. Meiste Volksrechte ahnden nur Binden Freier; Wilda 795. Nur Lex Burgund. 32, 3 hat ganz abweichend: si servum ligaverit, solvat ei sol. 3 et multae nomine sol. III

[Change ² to ¹] Violation of the protection (see that word in Gl 20a IV) of a common freeman; ibid. 15. Most of the folk-laws punish only the binding of free men; Wilda 795. Only Lex Burgund. 32, 3, quite exceptionally, has: si servum ligaverit, solvat ei sol. 3 et multae nomine sol. III
note.note: Printed ² in vol. I; Liebermann corrects it to ¹ (III p. 16).
